Fusion projectiles attach and detonate with a delayed Void blast.

Fires proximity seven bolts that deal impact damage and explode after 5 seconds or on enemy proximity. 

Due to repeated bugs and exploits, these bolts are now immune to all forms of premature destruction.

Upon detonation, each bolt deals <pve 236 /> <pvp [47] /> damage in a 4 meter radius, down to a minimum of 12.5% damage at the edge of the radius.
